Today let us discuss something about Mindcraft. What is Mindcraft? Can you think of that before answering this question?

```{python}
#| label: fig-polar
#| fig-cap: "A line plot on a polar axis"

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r = np.arange(0, 2, 0.01)
theta = 4 * np.pi * r
fig, ax = plt.subplots(
  subplot_kw = {'projection': 'polar'} 
)
ax.plot(theta, r)
ax.set_rticks([0.5, 1, 1.5, 2])
ax.grid(True)
plt.show()
```

```{=html}
<div class="giscus"></div>
<script>
(() => {
  const supportedGiscusLanguages = new Set([
    "ar", "be", "bg", "ca", "cs", "da", "de", "en", "eo", "es",
    "eu", "fa", "fr", "gr", "gsw", "hbs", "he", "hu", "id", "it", "ja", "kh",
    "ko", "nl", "pl", "pt", "ro", "ru", "th", "tr", "uk", "uz",
    "vi", "zh-CN", "zh-Hans", "zh-Hant", "zh-HK", "zh-TW"
  ]);

  function getGiscusLanguage() {
    const languages = navigator.languages?.length
      ? navigator.languages
      : [navigator.language || "en"];

    for (const language of languages) {
      const locale = language.replace("_", "-");
      const normalized = locale.toLowerCase();

      if (normalized === "zh" || normalized.startsWith("zh-")) {
        if (normalized.includes("-hans")) return "zh-CN";
        if (normalized.endsWith("-hk")) return "zh-HK";
        if (normalized.includes("-hant") || /-(tw|mo)$/.test(normalized)) return "zh-TW";
        return "zh-CN";
      }

      const exact = [...supportedGiscusLanguages].find(
        (supported) => supported.toLowerCase() === normalized
      );
      if (exact) return exact;

      const base = normalized.split("-")[0];
      const aliases = { el: "gr", km: "kh" };
      if (aliases[base]) return aliases[base];
      if (supportedGiscusLanguages.has(base)) return base;
    }

    return "en";
  }

  const giscusScript = document.createElement("script");
  giscusScript.src = "https://giscus.app/client.js";
  giscusScript.async = true;
  giscusScript.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
  giscusScript.dataset.repo = "boweitian/bowei.github.io";
  giscusScript.dataset.repoId = "R_kgDOKT-TdA";
  giscusScript.dataset.category = "Announcements";
  giscusScript.dataset.categoryId = "DIC_kwDOKT-TdM4DGi1n";
  giscusScript.dataset.mapping = "pathname";
  giscusScript.dataset.reactionsEnabled = "1";
  giscusScript.dataset.emitMetadata = "0";
  giscusScript.dataset.inputPosition = "top";
  giscusScript.dataset.theme = "light";
  giscusScript.dataset.lang = getGiscusLanguage();
  document.querySelector(".giscus").appendChild(giscusScript);
})();
</script>
```
